verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-retention windows and no deletion, redaction or PII-scrubbing endpoint for customer identity data. Related items do not qualify: a 5-second export download URL TTL, monitor/unmonitor configuration, and audit trails are different controls, not retention or erasure. A KYC/AML screening platform plausibly could offer this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
